results.evidence: _is_http_url now checks parsed.hostname, so 'http://:80' is rejected. The new test test_url_without_a_host_exits_1_and_writes_nothing runs log-event --stage buyer_need_confirmed --procurement-url http://:80 (and 3 other hostless URLs). It asserts the exit code equals EXIT_REFUSED, that stderr starts with the procurement-url error, and that the activities count and lead stage are unchanged. I ran the file with pytest and all 10 tests passed. I did not check that EXIT_REFUSED equals 1.
